sentences.text:
2.The case of the prosecution in brief:-
The de-facto complainant lodged a complaint stating that she was studying BE in Bharathi Women's College, Pudukkottai.
In 2021, she became friendly with the accused Nanthakumar through Instragram.
The above said friendship continued for two years.
Later, when she saw him in person, she came to know that he was already known to her and belongs to Vadakadu Servaikaranpatti village.
Later, they became lovers.
On 28/05/2022, Nanthakumar asked her to come to Pudukkottai.
She was taken to a lodge stating that they are going to become husband and wife, compelling her sexual intercourse.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
Under compulsion, she was subjected to sexual intercourse.
Later, he tried to avoid her.
After 15 days, she went to Nanthakumar's house and enquired.
At that time, she was abused in filthy language by calling her caste name.

On the basis of the complaint given by the de-facto complainant, a case in Crime No.2 of 2023 was registered for the offences under sections 294(b), 417 and 376(i) IPC and section 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w)(i) and 3(2)(v)
of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.
3.Now seeking direction to consider the bail application, on the date of surrender itself, this petition came to be filed.
4.Heard both sides.
5.No doubt that merits of the case beyond the scope of the direction under section 482 Cr.P.C.

But however, considering the seriousness of the allegation that has been made against the petitioner,
unless strong case has been made out by the petitioner for exercising the jurisdiction under section 482 Cr.P.C, it is not https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis available to the petitioner.
Section 482 Cr.P.C can be exercised, only when there is abuse of the process of court or to render justice to the parties.
Here, the allegations are serious in nature.

6.The learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that direction should not be issued and the petitioner must be subjected to custodial interrogation also and since, it is a case of rape,
medical examination of the victim as well as the accused must be undertaken.

Nanthakumar vs The Deputy Superintendent Of Police on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68062225/
2 7.Per contra, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that both are major and even as per the allegation made in the FIR, it is consensual in nature.
8.Here, the merit cannot be considered and discussed by this court.

sentences.text: It is for the trial court to consider the bail application at the appropriate time.
So, the petitioner either has to surrender to the respondent or before the concerned Special Court and seek regular bail.
9.Perusal of the CD file shows that only the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis victim was subjected to medical examination.
Since the petitioner was not subjected to interrogation, it was not undertaken so far.

So, I am of considered view that this is not a fittest case to exercise the jurisdiction under section 482 Cr.P.C, to give a direction to the Special Court to consider the bail application on the date of surrender itself.
10.In the result, this criminal original petition is dismissed.
